correctness.rationale: All 5 parameter branches are proved by direct recurrence. In uniformly contracting or expanding cases, geometric Neumann correction series yield the upper bound and finite directional unit-coordinate forcing with arbitrarily long tails yields sharp lower limits. In favorable a>1>b case, separate forward sums on n>0 and backward sums on n<0 with y_k(0)=0 solve the exact recurrence, and disjoint support yields the stated ell_p sum; two disjoint unit-forcing space-time paths impose both lower loads simultaneously. If a<1<b a single impulse forces unbounded right growth; unit weights admit characteristic-line forcing accumulating infinitely over time. Explicit x_n=(b/lambda)^n or (lambda/a)^(-n) proves b<|lambda|<a eigenvalue on finite p, illustrating nonhyperbolicity. Independently checked forcing paths for a=2,b=.4 at lengths 3,10,30 approach the sharp p=2 sum, without treating finite witnesses as universal proof.
residual_risks: The formula assumes positive step-constant weights; does not extend to arbitrary nonuniform weights.
Qualitative weighted-shift shadowing is prior, and a finite diagnostic alone cannot establish worst-case constants.

value.rationale: Optimal shadowing constants are natural robust dynamical invariants, and the favorable mixed interface is nonhyperbolic yet admits sharp Lipschitz shadowing. The two-tail p-sum distinguishes different Banach exponents and corrects what a naive maximum-of-tail-rates estimate would miss, with directly reusable formulas for a complete natural model family.
residual_risks: Fixed single interface and positive weights only; does not quantify perturbation robustness or variable-weight shifts.

final_claim: For positive step-constant forward weights a on n<=0 and b on n>=1, the exact optimal uniform two-sided error-correction constant on ell_p(Z), 1<=p<=infinity, is 1/(1-max(a,b)) if both contract, 1/(min(a,b)-1) if both expand, the p-sum of (a-1)^-1 and (1-b)^-1 if a>1>b (maximum at p=infinity), and infinity otherwise.
limitations: Complete all-positive-parameter p-constant for a single step interface; qualitative shadowing classification is previous work. Inaccessible 2026 Pinto text remains explicit priority risk.
